facts.fact: Adwave runs paid media on Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one prepaid daily budget starting at $30/day, per the vendor's own page.
facts.quote: from one prepaid daily budget starting at **$30/day**

facts.fact: The vendor states that the $30/day floor does not apply to every network on day one, since Reddit and Google Search typically need a higher daily budget before they switch on.
facts.quote: Reddit and Google Search typically need a higher daily budget before they switch on.

facts.fact: The vendor's page says agency fees under a percent-of-spend model are often discussed in a rough band of 10% to 20% of media spend, and that this is not a rate card or survey average.
facts.quote: Often discussed in a rough 10% to 20% band.

facts.fact: The vendor's page states that the sketch of a $2,000 monthly advertising budget, fee included, is an illustration and not a quote.
facts.quote: Say the business can put **$2,000** in a month toward advertising, fee included. This is a sketch so the shapes are visible. It is not a quote.

facts.fact: Adwave states that users approve ads before any spend occurs.
facts.quote: You approve ads before you spend.

facts.fact: The vendor's page is dated July 30, 2026 as its published time.
Adwave states that its campaigns can run across Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one prepaid daily budget.
facts.quote: The campaign can include Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one prepaid daily budget, with radius or ZIP targeting and a first-party site tracker.

facts.fact: Adwave states that media starts at $30 per day.
Adwave states that Search and Reddit typically unlock at a higher daily budget than the starting media minimum.
facts.quote: Search and Reddit typically unlock at a higher daily budget.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its media product is a prepaid daily budget that the customer can pause, and that it is separate from any agency contract.
facts.quote: The product is a prepaid daily budget you can pause. That is separate from any contract you sign with an agency.

facts.fact: Adwave states that an agency agreement can still have a term and should be read separately from the Adwave media product.
facts.quote: An agency agreement can still have a term. Read that agreement on its own.
